I am not able to write answer for BPT 2. In BPT 1 I am not facing any issues but in BPT 2 there is permission denied issue. Please provide regarding this.

posts.name: Chaitanya Mishra
posts.cooked:
Seems you are in the root directory.
You are supposed to work in your

home directory->se2001->BPT2_problemX folder

posts.name: Chaitanya Mishra
posts.cooked:
image648×371 6.71 KB

Yes but not in your home. Check the highlighted part in the screenshot. Now do
cd
cd se2001
cd BPT2_problem_1 (if not created do mkdir BPT2_problem_1 then cd)
synchro show (to get the problem statement)

After solving
do synchro eval

posts.name: Om Garg
posts.cooked: When i clicked the screenshot at that time i am in cd /opt/se2001/BPT2_problem_1 then typed nano script.sh and try to save then this error appeared

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
That is what is being told. You are not supposed to work in that directory.
Please go through filesystem basics and read the README file in your home directory. You won’t be able to use the VM if you’re not familiar with basics of navigating in a command line.
